notes.title: PlinkIdle Demo in the Works
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Steam!
[/p][p]We’ve been working hard on a PlinkIdle demo. It's tightened up from the original game we launched on web, prettier, and way more playable with a new core loop.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re aiming to release it during a focused event instead of throwing it into the Next Fest firehose. Thanks so much for wishlisting and following![/p][p][/p][p]We're really looking forward to engaging with the community here.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630093/784fe88e761f7859a1087f521c3cfe60cdefd2e9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630093/58faca1abfecf73a6f30f6979297fbbf00767ac6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630093/52d1b8429c098f1dbf60e1440e74e3e663eba4b1.png"][/img][/carousel]
